The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with revenue of $1,207M, an operating margin of 22% ($263M), and positive net income of $106M. However, its financial profile carries significant risk, characterized by high leverage (total liabilities of $4,392M against equity of $1,381M, resulting in a Debt-to-Equity equivalent ratio of over 3x) and weak short-term liquidity, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.72 ($564M in current assets vs. $783M in current liabilities). This combination of strong operating performance alongside high leverage and tight liquidity is characteristic of a mid-to-lower investment-grade or high-yield borrower.

DECISION: BB-
